scope: Only RO0000 data with direct impact on the single-player StoneAge world, battle, item, skill and runtime behavior.

semantics: MAP_readMapConfFile loads image-number keyed map attributes.
MAP_BATTLEMAP / MAP_BATTLEMAP2 / MAP_BATTLEMAP3 store battle-map selectors.
status-area fields include MAP_INTODARKNESS, MAP_INTOCONFUSION, MAP_OUTOFPOISON, MAP_OUTOFPARALYSIS and related state effects.
map/mapset.txt.conclusion: Endpoint data and hydata are identical; no variant selection is required.

magic.txt.semantics: Loaded by MAGIC_initMagic(getMagicfile()); source rows encode named magic, effect function, power/options and magic category.

itematom.txt.semantics: Loaded by ITEM_initItemAtom(getItematomfile()); material/ingredient atom definitions used by item composition/crafting logic.

effect.txt.semantics: Configured as the encounter/effect configuration file; rows are floor/effect/level/date-time/duration records.

inv.txt.semantics: Loaded through invinciblefile; parser supports INV/ITM/MAG area kinds controlling invincible zones, no-drop zones and no-magic zones.
inv.txt.conclusion: The snapshot content is identical to Fixed-C but decodes to non-readable UTF-8 glyphs rather than valid INV/ITM/MAG text. Do not invent area records.

battlemap.txt.semantics: $ headers define 1-3 candidate battle-map numbers; range rows assign them to image numbers; battle selection chooses among the candidate slots.
battlemap.txt.conclusion: Already source-closed; one reversed range (3137 to 1349) remains invalid source data and must not be silently normalized.

petskill2.txt.conclusion: Use endpoint data variant as the primary single-player source; preserve hydata variant.

skillcode.txt.semantics: Fixed-C Load_PetSkillCodes reads ./data/skillcode.txt and stores name, TempNo, PetId and Code. Code participates in special pet-skill eligibility checks.
skillcode.txt.conclusion: Use endpoint data/skillcode.txt as primary; do not merge variant mappings.

exclusions: historical backups/residue without proven runtime admission
features with no demonstrated single-player relevance
